category.name: Architecture, CAD and BIM
category.description: Building information models, CAD geometry, construction management and GIS platforms with programmatic access.

entries.name: Autodesk Platform Services (APS)
entries.desc_en: Upload, translate, view and automate CAD/BIM files (Model Derivative, Data Management, Design Automation) via REST APIs.
entries.notes: Successor to Autodesk Forge; requires an Autodesk account and app registration in the APS console.

entries.name: Bentley iTwin Platform APIs
entries.free_tier: free developer sign-up/trial, then consumption-based pricing
entries.desc_en: Create, manage and query digital twins, iModels and reality/reporting data for infrastructure projects via REST APIs.
entries.notes: Built on iTwin.js; free developer account, but production data volumes/usage are billed.

entries.name: Esri ArcGIS Location Platform
entries.auth_hint: API key (token param) or OAuth2 Bearer token
entries.free_tier: free tier with monthly free credits, then usage-based pricing
entries.desc_en: Geocode addresses, render maps, run spatial analysis and manage geospatial site data via REST APIs and SDKs.
entries.notes: Free sign-up; usage beyond free monthly credits is billed per service call.

entries.name: Onshape REST API
entries.auth_hint: HMAC-signed API key pair (access/secret) for personal scripts, or OAuth2 Bearer token for published apps
entries.free_tier: free tier (public documents only); private documents need a paid plan
entries.desc_en: Create, read and modify Onshape CAD documents, parts, assemblies and drawings programmatically via REST API.
entries.notes: Free-tier API access is limited to public documents; private/commercial use needs a paid Onshape subscription.

entries.name: Procore API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <token> (OAuth2 authorization code / client credentials)
entries.free_tier: free developer sandbox; production requires customer's paid Procore plan
entries.desc_en: Read and write construction project data - RFIs, submittals, drawings, budgets, schedules - via REST API.
entries.notes: Requires joining the Procore Developer Program and OAuth app approval for production scopes; sandbox is free.

entries.name: Rhino.Compute (McNeel)
entries.auth_hint: optional RhinoComputeKey header; endpoint is otherwise open once deployed
entries.free_tier: self-hosted only; requires a Rhino license, cloud deployment billed by core-hour
entries.desc_en: Run Rhino/Grasshopper geometry operations headlessly via a stateless REST API you deploy yourself.
entries.notes: Not a hosted SaaS signup - must self-host on Windows/Linux (IIS, Azure, AWS); requires a Rhino license.

entries.name: Speckle API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <personal access token>, or OAuth2 for published apps
entries.free_tier: free Explore plan (1 project, 3 users), unlimited API calls
entries.desc_en: Send, receive and query 3D/BIM model data across CAD tools (Revit, Rhino, Grasshopper, Tekla) via GraphQL API and SDKs.
entries.notes: Open-source data platform; free tier has unlimited API calls but limits project/user counts.

entries.name: Trimble Connect API
entries.desc_en: Manage Trimble Connect projects, files, BIM models, issues/topics and metadata via REST APIs (Core, Model, Organizer).
entries.notes: Requires a Trimble Identity developer account and a registered application.

entries.name: Zoo Text-to-CAD API (KittyCAD)
entries.free_tier: start free trial credits, then usage-based pay-as-you-go
entries.desc_en: Generate 3D CAD models from text prompts and run modeling/file-conversion operations via REST API.
entries.notes: ML endpoints handle text-to-CAD generation; base API URL is api.zoo.dev, OpenAPI schema served from there.
